newsitem.title: USA: Hytek sees Q3 earnings below Q2.
newsitem.headline: Hytek sees Q3 earnings below Q2.

text.p: Hytek Microsystems Inc said Monday it expects revenue and earnings for the third quarter to be below those of the previous quarter but above the year-ago period.

The cause for the drop is that Chesapeake Sciences Corp, which has accounted for 75 percent of Hytek revenues during the first six months of 1996, has stretched out the delivery schedule for the remainder of 1996.
The move is expected to shift some $800,000 of revenues from the current year into fiscal 1997.
Hytek called the situation a temporary adjustment but warned that since future orders cannot be guaranteed there is a risk revenue and earnings could decline further.
